comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs remove a drill battery by squeezing two buttons.
comparison.physical_skill: One blade beneath a recessed tab with simultaneous wire/tool pull vs stabilizing a drill, simultaneously pressing two releases, and sliding a large pack.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone vs battery separates and rests in the tray while drill displacement remains limited.
comparison.reason: Both are retained-part removal, but the candidate tests tool-mediated internal latch access and coupled extraction rather than simultaneous button actuation.
